errors.text_span: The tallest bars, indicating the highest CoLeG-R scores, are consistently the pink bars (“+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”)
errors.evidence: This claim is incorrect. For the LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B model groups, the purple bar ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁') is the tallest, not the pink bar.
The pink bar for the LLaMA-2-13B group reaches a value of approximately 80%, not 83%.

errors.text_span: The shortest bars, representing “no SFT”, are the light blue bars
errors.evidence: This claim is not consistently true. In the LLaMA-2-7B group, the orange bar ('+ SFT on D₀') is the shortest at approximately 66%, while the light blue bar ('no SFT') is higher at approximately 67%.
The value for the light blue bar in the LLaMA-2-70B group is approximately 81%, which is visibly above the 80% tick mark.
